dataset: HTAD: Home-Tasks Activities Dataset (wrist accelerometer + audio)
authors: Garcia-Ceja E, Thambawita V, Hicks S, et al.
acquisition: wrist accelerometer @ ~31 Hz, 3 subjects, 7 home tasks incl. WASHING HANDS (d510), brushing teeth, eating chips, sweeping/mopping, typing, watch TV
note: Small N (3 subjects): a demonstration that washing hands is recognisable above chance from a real wrist accelerometer, NOT a definitive validation.
